event_summary: Two small spheres moved across a light tabletop in opposite directions and then left the frame.
raw_event_description: The video begins with an empty light wood-grain tabletop between two black cylindrical fixtures near the left and right edges. After several unchanged frames, a partial hand appears briefly at the right edge, a small brown sphere appears in the upper-right area and moves toward the upper-left area, and a light gray sphere appears from the left/lower area and moves toward the right/lower area. The two spheres are visible at the same time while separated vertically, then the brown sphere leaves near the upper-left edge and the gray sphere leaves near the right edge. The tabletop is empty again afterward.

reasons: The tabletop and side fixtures are visible before the moving spheres appear.
The moving spheres are not visible in the first frame.

A skin-toned partial hand or fingers appears briefly at the right edge near the right black cylinder.
A small brown sphere appears near the right side of the tabletop in the upper half of the frame.
A small light gray sphere appears near the left side of the tabletop in the lower half of the frame.
The brown sphere changes position across the upper half of the tabletop toward the left side.
The light gray sphere changes position across the lower and middle portion of the tabletop toward the right side.
The two spheres are visible at the same time with the brown sphere above the light gray sphere in the frame.
The brown sphere reaches the upper-left edge area and then is no longer visible.
The light gray sphere reaches the right edge area and then is no longer visible.
After both spheres leave, the tabletop is again visible without the spheres.
The framing of the tabletop and black side cylinders remains fixed throughout the video.
